usage.source_scope: 人体姿态、接触邻近与净空共同定义可供性。
usage.project_application: 用于座位和可接近区域：从“这是椅子”升级为“该位置是否支持目标人体姿态且有必要净空”。
usage.modifications: 只借用 contact/clearance verifier；不生成用户身体轨迹，不把 crowd preference 当 BlindAssist 用户效果。
usage.expected_effect: 过滤类别正确但被堵塞、尺度不合或缺少人体净空的交互位置。

evaluation.setup: 未执行；最小证伪实验：冻结座位检测，在可坐、被占、净空不足和未知几何的小型新鲜集上仅加入人体 contact/clearance；主指标为 interaction-ready precision 和 NOT_EVALUABLE 分母。
evaluation.claim_boundary: AROS 在三维扫描与众包偏好上的结果不能外推到盲人导航；BlindAssist 未复现，成功也只支持命名几何 verifier。

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.
